raw:
Agent Name: WebSurfer
Step Number: 6
Reason for Mistake: The WebSurfer incorrectly claimed that “the fascists remained in power in Albania until 1944,” misinterpreting the search results and conflating German occupation with the Albanian Fascist Party’s tenure. Authoritative sources visible in the results (e.g., Wikipedia) consistently stated the Albanian Fascist Party held nominal power until 1943 (Italy’s capitulation). This unsupported assertion introduced the wrong year and led the reasoning astray.
